plan_pedagogique.objectif: Explain why conditionals and structured paragraphs are essential to score B2/C1 in high school essays.
plan_pedagogique.contenu_attendu: How to move beyond simple opinions to articulate nuanced hypotheses and well-supported arguments.

plan_pedagogique.objectif: Contrast 1st conditional (real future), 2nd conditional (imaginary present), and 3rd conditional (regret in the past).
plan_pedagogique.contenu_attendu: Structures : If + present, will / If + preterit, would / If + had + past participle, would have + past participle.

plan_pedagogique.objectif: Introduce the PEEL method for bulletproof body paragraphs.
plan_pedagogique.contenu_attendu: Point (Topic sentence), Evidence (Concrete fact/quote), Explanation (Why it matters), Link (Connecting back to the main thesis).

plan_pedagogique.objectif: Demonstrate a complete high-school argumentative paragraph on Artificial Intelligence and ethics.
plan_pedagogique.contenu_attendu: Writing model incorporating a second conditional hypothesis and sophisticated linking words.

plan_pedagogique.objectif: Warn against the classic error 'If I would have' instead of 'If I had'.
plan_pedagogique.contenu_attendu: Never put 'would' inside the 'if' clause : 'If I had known' (correct) vs 'If I would have known' (incorrect).

plan_pedagogique.objectif: Summarize the grammar matrix and PEEL essay checklist.
plan_pedagogique.contenu_attendu: Quick recap table for exam day revision.
